sources.title: The Ultimate A to Z Learn-A-Thon 📖✏️ | Learn to Read | Alphablocks
sources.snippet:
Alphablocks is the hit CBeebies TV show that’s helping hundreds of thousands of children learn to read. The Alphablocks are 26 living letters who discover that whenever they hold hands and make a word, something magical happens.
Learn to read and spell easy, intermediate and hard words with the phonetic spelling technique designed especially for kids learning to read. [...] In this educational marathon, children not only traverse through the A to Z of letters but also engage in the captivating world of reading. Through engaging activities and dynamic storytelling, kids will experience the joy of mastering the alphabet and enhancing their reading abilities. Join us for this immersive educational adventure, where the alphabet comes to life, making the journey of learning to read an exciting and rewarding experience for young minds with Alphablocks. sources.snippet: アルファブロックス（Alphablocks）とは？ アルファブロックス（Alphablocks）は、英語の読みの基礎となるフォニックスが学べるイギリスの教育番組です。
